title: Habakkuk 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The wickedness of the land. The fearful vengeance to be executed.
These judgments to be inflicted by a nation more wicked than themselves.

outline.text: The wickedness of the land. The fearful vengeance to be executed.
These judgments to be inflicted by a nation more wicked than themselves.

context: The subject of this prophecy is the destruction of Judea and Jerusalem for the sins of the people, and the consolation of the faithful under national calamities.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.

title: Habakkuk 3: chapter overview
paragraphs: The prophet beseeches God for his people.
He calls to mind former deliverances.
His firm trust in the Divine mercy.
